entry.title: ThinkEdit: Fixing the ‘Too Short to Think’ Problem in Reasoning Models

link.title: ThinkEdit: Fixing the ‘Too Short to Think’ Problem in Reasoning Models

entry.content: Read the full post on Medium: ThinkEdit: Fixing the “Too Short to Think” Problem in Reasoning Models.
entry.summary: Reasoning LLMs sometimes cut their chain-of-thought short right when a problem needs more deliberation. This post digs into why that happens and how targeted activation edits can fix it.
